BUILD FOUR SETS, NOT A WARDROBE.
Part 4 of 7 · Appearance · the Attractive pillar
FROM HERE ON: SIGNALING, NOT BIOLOGY — a system to remove the decision, not a law of nature.
THE DEMAND SELECTOR — INDEX BY DEMAND, NOT BY MOOD
POINT AT THE DEMAND — THE SET IS ALREADY BUILT.
can't be faked → see a tailor
spend first where you wear most
THE GSM GAUGE · the one lever worth obsessing over — fabric weight under every set above
SHAPE COMES FROM THE FABRIC, NOT THE BODY.
classify once → half the decisions pre-made
most MY / SE-Asian men sit warm-to-neutral
→ soft white & cream beat stark white
soft white, not stark — nothing out-shouts the face
USEFUL DEFAULT, NOT LAW — no “colour of the season.”
THE FOOTWEAR FOUNDATION — FOUR PAIRS, MAINTAINED
LEATHER → LEATHER (brown shoe = brown belt) · METAL → METAL (silver = silver) · mismatch = a tell of inattention
maintain before you buy a fifth
you paid for the logo, not the fabric.
<140 GSM · limp · brand & price are weak predictors
FOUR DEMANDS. FOUR SETS. ZERO CYCLES.
index the demand → upgrade the fabric → classify colour once → match the shoes · spend on tailoring & fabric, not the logo.
A SYSTEM, SO YOU NEVER DECIDE AGAIN.
